description: A Hidden Mickey is tucked low on the wall just past the large U.S.A. map in the queue. It sits beneath a green dinosaur and a red fish, partially obscured by handrails on the left side, making it easy to miss unless you're looking near the floor.

whereToLook.scene: Wall display past the large U.S.A. map in the queue
whereToLook.exactSpot: Below the green dinosaur and red fish, near the floor behind the handrails on the left side

bestTip: Scan low along the wall after passing the map. Most guests never look below handrail height.

viewing.notes: The handrails partially block the view. You may need to lean slightly or wait for space in the queue.
